name: Zadok (son of Azor)
title: Link in the genealogy of Jesus
summary: Zadok is the son of Azor and the father of Akim in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Matthew. He belongs to the third group of fourteen generations, from the Babylonian exile to Christ, and is known only from this list. He is not the same person as Zadok the high priest in the time of David and Solomon.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus
keyEvents.description: Matthew names Zadok as the son of Azor and the father of Akim.
